content.text: Knife voice · serial hunger (not sexual)
Companion to Necromantic. Open Debug to verify F4SE / forms.
Enter Pickman Gallery (interior) or obtain / equip Pickman's Blade. A voice bonds with the wielder — toast-only for Slice A.

Once bonded, hunger rises with unused knife-time. High hunger applies Knife Hunger withdrawal (AGI/CHA −1). Kill a non-essential human with Pickman's Blade to sate hunger (praise toast + sated window).
With Pickman's Blade drawn, aim at a dead adult woman and press / to open the butcher menu. Choose a limb — same combat gore (piece stays visible). Skipped during Necromantic scenes.
After the bond, sometimes a corpse appears in your bed when you sleep. Look away and she is gone. Toggle under Voice.
Soft load order: Occult Pact → Pickman's Whisper → Necromantic. This mod is not sexual; Necromantic handles corpse scenes afterward.

content.help: Undoes one knife-hunger SPECIAL pair if ModValue stacked. Click until SPECIAL is correct. Does not re-apply the penalty.
Clears hunger and plays a praise line without a real kill.
Clears BondStarted so the next bond poll re-triggers StartBond and the bond toast — lets you retest bonding without hunting for a pre-bond save.
When hunger is high, apply AGI/CHA withdrawal stand-in.
Idle growth while bonded and not sated. Default 5.
After satiation (Slice B knife kill / debug button).
How notices are delivered. Toast and Audio (default): HUD toast and matching whisper clip. Audio only: clip with no toast. Toast only: toast with no audio.
While bonded, occasionally spawn an ephemeral corpse in your bed on sleep. Look away after seeing her and she vanishes. Pure vignette — no hunger change.
Comments on the nearest non-hostile adult female in range (C2). Honors Voice delivery mode.
Re-reads NoticeLines_*.txt and *_Audio.txt from disk (no game restart) and reports load status.

content.text: Notice text: Data/PickmansWhisper/config/NoticeLines_*.txt. Audio maps: *_Audio.txt (.xwm filenames). Clips: Data/Sound/PickmansWhisper/. See Debug for load status.
Face someone in-world for ~2s (killscan caches them), then open this page. "Load targeted victim" re-pushes Aimed / Decay / named list from that cache — it does not re-scan the world.

content.help: Face someone in-world for ~2s (killscan caches them), then open this page. "Load targeted victim" re-pushes the cache only.

Current decay for the cached victim. Named victims without a clock start Freshly Deceased. Blade kills stamp automatically. Overlays apply via KillerScan sync after you close MCM (may take several seconds).
Up to 8 names from the saved FormID table (cap 32). "Leslie x2" means two different NPCs share that name.
Re-push Aimed / Decay / named list from the killscan cache. Opens a MessageBox so you can confirm the button fired. Face her in-world before opening MCM.

content.text: Toggle "can't be killed" on the aimed NPC for a beat-before-kill fight (Slice J1). Same eligibility as a valid knife-kill target: human, adult female, not essential/child/teammate, seen non-hostile. Pressing again while she's essential (that this toggle set) turns it back off — an NPC essential for any other reason is never touched.

content.help: ☑ = essential via this toggle right now; ☐ = not (or not eligible). Refreshes on "Load targeted victim" and after pressing Toggle essential below.
Sets/clears SetEssential on the aimed NPC. Status row above updates immediately after.
Idle, or the current AAF scene phase (Starting/Playing/Cancelling) plus the target's FormID. Updates on scene events and panel refresh.

Frees the aimed slave directly, without starting a scene. The activate-menu "Take Her" choice (Slice U) starts an AAF scene instead of freeing once she's already enslaved — use this button for a plain, no-scene release.

content.text: Type a real name, then "Apply name". That becomes her world/HUD name and fills {name} in whispers. Generics (Settler, Resident) are rejected.

content.help: Real name only (e.g. Marie). Not Settler/Resident. Then press "Apply name".
GardenOfEden2.SetDisplayName on the aimed / last-look actor + save FormID↔name for whispers.

On by default. When on: LooksMenu body skins + face masks follow the decay stage on knife/world corpses (can conflict with Real HD Faces — load Real HD after Pickman's Whisper). When off: murder clock and stage labels still advance; no world-corpse paint. Bed gift vignette still paints.

Off by default. When off: a corpse missing a limb or the head is skipped for body decal decay (stump-edge UV glow protection) — clock/face still advance as normal. When on: overrides that skip and paints body decals on a dismembered corpse exactly like a fully-limbed one.

content.text: Testing only. Pick a stage, press "Set decay stage" (or "Reset decay stage"), then close the dialog and MCM — overlays apply to the aimed corpse within about a second (requires Corpse decay visuals ON). Freshly (0) = no body skins; Pallor (1) = tinted SkinTexture_16; Livor (2)+ = heavier Porcupine skins. Face masks start at stage 2. "Load targeted victim" refreshes Aimed + Decay rows immediately.

content.help: Testing only. Choose ModConfig stage, then press "Set decay stage", then close dialog + MCM. Stage 0 = body none; Pallor (1) = tinted SkinTexture_16; stage 2+ heavier skins + face.
Backdates murder time by ModConfig startHours, then queues overlay apply on the aimed corpse as soon as you leave MCM.
Sets murder time to now and Pick stage to Freshly Deceased, then queues overlay apply on the aimed corpse when you leave MCM.
CallGlobalFunction Debug.MessageBox — no quest required.

params:
Pickman's Whisper MCM PING (global)

MCM CallGlobalFunction works.

content.help: CallFunction on Main quest with scriptName — must MessageBox if quest wiring is OK.
MessageBox: bond, blade, KillerScan/VoiceScan casts, scan tick, last dispatch, notice/fixation status, hunger cooldown. Use this before guessing why whispers are silent.
Blade status, scan heartbeats, HUMAN kill / ignore reasons. Off by default. Praise and hunger voice are separate (Voice page).

Temporary Slice H P5 diagnostic. Off by default. When on, Traces the FormID of EVERY magic effect applied to the player (Papyrus.0.log) — used to confirm which effect the Cannibal perk's heal actually applies. Turn off when done; it is noisy.
Slice G testing: skip the ~12 game-hour bed-gift cooldown so a corpse can appear every sleep. Turn off for normal cadence.
Auto MessageBox every ~8s while notice polling: who was nearby and why each failed or passed. No button needed. Turn off when done debugging.
Current whisper escalation stage. When 'Force notice stage' is off this tracks hunger (updates on Refresh). When on, this pins the stage so you can test each one without grinding hunger.
When on, the Notice stage dropdown overrides the hunger-derived stage (debug/testing).
Updates every ~2s when KillerScan reaches VoiceScan. If stuck on (none yet), voice never got the call.
Aim-edge counts on eligible NPCs (seen xN). Ambient hunger whispers unchanged.
Unfiltered GoE living + detecting scan within kill-watch radius. Verifies detection before notice filters.
GoE check: PASS only when Pickman's Blade is actually drawn (not a gun with blade in inventory).
Reloads all five NoticeLines_*.txt via GoE2 and pops a MessageBox with the full path/exists/raw/parsed/RESULT trace (Necromantic-style). Screenshot this if load fails.
D0-POC: Sound.Play on PW_Whisper_EndIt (FormID xx000807 → Sound\PickmansWhisper\EndIt.xwm). Quit FO4 to desktop after deploy so MCM reloads this button.
Slice G: spawn the bed-hallucination corpse beside the player (no sleep). Look at her, then look away to clear.
Slice G: despawn the ephemeral bed corpse immediately.
Slice F: open the butcher limb menu on aimed (or last-look) dead adult female. Requires Pickman's Blade drawn. Works from MCM.
Slice F: sever Head1 on aimed (or last-look) dead adult female. Requires Pickman's Blade drawn. No limb menu.
Slice U AAF scene normally requires an interior cell (exteriors are CTD-prone for AAF scene starts). Default off.
Force-stops the current AAF slave scene, if any.
